answer: Reputation here is a refundable bond locked until unrelated-funder older peers grade work over epochs. A sybil farm cannot fake that history: keys that share wallets, timing, or phrasing swarm like one nebula of common capital and get folded into a single vote. Extra fake accounts add no real signal for graders. A copied answer rides in on the same zephyr as the original and slashes the linked bonds across the cluster.
